tips: A Jedi uses the Force for knowledge and defense, never for attack.
Always check the exhaust port before declaring your battle station complete.
Always let a wookiee win. They're sore losers.
Always pay your debts to Jabba on time.
Do or do not. There is no try.
Don't get cocky.
Don't stick your hand in the trash compactor. Or anywhere near the dianoga.
Don't underestimate the power of the Dark Side.
Fear leads to anger. Anger leads to hate. Hate leads to suffering.
If you're cold, a tauntaun will keep you warm. Briefly.
It's a trap!
Keep your blaster close. Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side.
Never bargain with Jabba without a backup plan.
Never call a wookiee 'fuzzball'.
Never fly into an asteroid field when you could fly around it.
Never tell Han Solo the odds.
Patience you must have.
Size matters not.
Stay on target.
The Force is with you.
They aren't the droids you're looking for. Move along.
Wars not make one great.
